content: चन {%ind.%} Not, not also, even not; आपश्चन प्र मिनाति व्रतं वाम् <ls>Rv. 2. 24. 12</ls>; (not used by itself, but found used in combination with the pronoun किम् or its derivatives, such as कद्, कथं, क्व, कदा, कुतः to which it imparts an indefinite sense; see under किम्). {%Note%}:-- Some regard चन to be not a separate word, but a combination of च and न.
